Trigger You Diagnose a creature bearing at least one bio-augment.

When you Diagnose a creature carrying bio-augments, you also read exactly how strained the grafts sit in it: its current Load, its current Resonance, and which of its slots the grafts occupy. If a Grafted or Wild-sourced augment among them carries a donor thread, you catch a flicker of it too — the GM decides how much.
